name: Dafy V-Integra Adult Dog homemade diet balancer
note: WARNING for kidney diets: contains 5.2% phosphorus (monopotassium phosphate) and 7.5% potassium - the label dose for 6-10 kg (3-7 g/day) adds 156-364 mg P/day. Use only if your vet agrees. Label: Ca 16.8%, P 5.2%, Na 2.2%, K 7.5%, Mg 1.5%, protein 5.8%, fat 2.6%, ash 79%, moisture 1.9%. Per kg: vit A 250,000 IU, D3 25,000 IU, B1 75 mg, B2 250 mg, B6 50 mg, B12 1.5 mg, C 1,250 mg, K3 40 mg, niacin 500 mg, Ca pantothenate 450 mg, folic acid 10 mg, biotin 2.5 mg, choline chloride 55,000 mg (= ~41,000 mg choline), taurine 25,000 mg, Fe 2,550 mg, Cu 250 mg, Mn 500 mg, Zn 2,500 mg, I 60 mg, Se 1.5 mg. No vitamin E declared (tocopherols only as antioxidant). Energy estimated. Scoop = 5 g. Introduce over 3 weeks (1/3, 2/3, full). Source: dafynutrition.com.
